name: Bounding Volume Extrusion
aliases: 6-triangle convex hull method for caustic beams
definition: A technique to generate tight bounding volumes for caustic beams (defined by bilinear patches) that can be rasterized, using a 6-triangle convex hull method instead of the standard bounding prism method.
summary: Bounding Volume Extrusion computes tight convex hulls for caustic beams using six triangles, offering superior accuracy over standard prisms for warped light.
